response.overview: An elderly widower lives alone until a child’s presence intrudes upon his home. This small visitor completely disrupts his isolation, stripping away the last tangible links he has to his late wife. In his attempt to recover them, the old man is forced to revisit forgotten corners of his own house. Despite his initial resistance, the child insists on leading him to an abandoned greenhouse—a space that once belonged to his wife. Amidst plants beginning to sprout anew and the heavy burden of grief, the two forge an unexpected bond that helps them process their loss. Only then does the old man feel ready to fulfill his final wish: a long-awaited reunion with her.
response.title: Retrato de una memoria
